plugins.name: review-map
plugins.description: Turn a diff, branch, PR or working tree into a reviewer-oriented map of the change, rendered as a styled HTML page.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Save the live state of a task to a scrubbed handoff file outside the repo, and resume from it in a fresh session.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Retrospectives for Claude Code: find what in the agent's environment slowed a session down, and propose evidence-backed fixes.

plugins.name: ticket-board
plugins.description: Slice a spec into reviewable tickets, review them on a styled HTML board, and publish and sync them as GitHub issues on a GitHub Project.
